node.title: Remanente no recuperable
node.summary: Some distinctions are absent from the available output or record.

relations: The calibration case distinguishes knowledge that can be taught through practice from information that an application inventory cannot reconstruct by itself.
No todo saber tácito es irrecuperable; distinguir falta de captura, coste de recuperación y pérdida efectiva.
Information that was never institutionally established differs from information that existed but cannot be recovered from the available record.
Ambas categorías pueden coexistir en una decisión; clasificarlas exige evidencia del caso.
Where a record cannot reconstruct situated judgment, capability preservation may require a live transmission relationship rather than another layer of documentation.
No afirmar que todo conocimiento tácito sea irrecuperable ni que mentoría garantice reconstrucción completa.
Reconstructing what a model omitted is different from recovering a capability that has ceased to be exercised; the bridge note keeps those repair problems distinct.
La irreversibilidad del marco requiere contraste; el enlace distingue problemas y no establece una tasa universal de pérdida.
